preserve: a source is a row of the person's list; a new kind of source or ranked-list reader is a row of watch-sources.json
only public addresses are read and nothing is sent outward
a source's first read is a quiet baseline; an item is kept once by its id or link
a run reads at most sources_per_run sources and weighs at most weighed_per_run items, the oldest open batch, in one question that is byte-identical until answered
an item not weighed stays New and is never dropped; a verdict naming another item's link is not applied
only what moves a pursuit is handed in, as an outside arrival on route watch-sources
a conditional read that answers 304 reads as nothing new and asks no model
a ranked list is read whole by its reader row; entries, climbs, falls and drop-outs are signals once per item and day
a whole history is named under history_wanted and kept once as From the history
the signals list is read once a run, its own values only, and each list is written once a run
allowed_deltas: lists are reached through any lists object the caller hands in, each call awaited, so the person's records door can serve them (read-data/lists-door.mjs)
a page's readable text comes from tools/browse-public-page extractPage, the function Trillion's readLinkCard built its card from
the store binding (watchSourcesActions) stays with the host that has a store; the Workshop run is do-work/watch-my-sources.mjs
paths in comments and data name this folder; one comment's account figure is left out
an item's short hash comes from tools/content-identity makeHashCodeHexFromBytes, the Workshop's one BLAKE3 owner, the same 24 hex characters the primitive gave
the sources list starts with three starter places, Show HN, Product Hunt and Launch YC, each turned off (folded in from tools/find-signals-of-need)
banned_substitutions: a second rule or measure language (thresholds use tools/formulas classify-by-rules over rule-operators.json)
